lessons.title: Lesson 1: Building the Foundation of Effective Communication in English
lessons.description: In this lesson, students will learn the basics of effective communication in English, including clear articulation, proper grammar, and sentence structure. Students will practice these skills through various exercises and activities designed to improve their ability to express themselves clearly and coherently.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Advanced Techniques for Presentation and Communication in English
lessons.description: This lesson focuses on advanced techniques for presenting and communicating in English. Students will learn how to structure their presentations, use persuasive language, and deliver their messages with confidence and impact. They will also engage in role-plays and discussions to apply these skills in real-world scenarios.
